rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANorelav
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, before 1992).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1994 as 'Red Velvet'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. 35 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.

rows.Notes: Carlton Rose Nurseries says this is currently probably the best florist red worldwide... dark red outer petals and very dark, tough foliage...
